author: Xdaj
content: Plan: Implement 6 remaining M12 optimizations as separate commits: (1) Tile-based erosion kernel with workgroup shared memory for Laplacian stencil, (2) Flow accumulation tuning with batch topo-sort and skip redundant recomputes, (3) Climate iteration reduction via prior-step initial guess, (4) Chunked snapshot transfer for level 9+, (5) f16 GPU buffer compression for bounded fields, (6) Perf regression test suite.
